text:
aditya: heads-up — paxos-inc reports missing audit events in their SIEM since last night's forwarder rollout. they say ~03:00–03:45 UTC gap, ~10k events missing from the 'policy.change' stream. anyone owning the export chain?

sam: pinging eng-security here. do we have their org id / example event ids? we should get a minimal repro query for splunk/siem.

aditya: org=paxos-inc, sample query they ran: `index=audit sourcetype=redwood_audit | where event_type="policy.change" | stats count by _time` — shows a flat gap for that window. attached a screenshot in the ticket. ticket#INC-7192.

kevin: I pulled forwarder logs for the window. seeing repeated `WARN skipped object due to AccessDenied` on s3 GETs. excerpt:```2026-11-03T03:12:14Z forwarder[proc:upload] WARN s3.GetObject failed key=audit/2026/11/03/03/part-0003.gz err=AccessDenied status=403 request_id=ABC123 deferrer=retry``` looks like S3 perms or KMS decrypt?

maria: KMS errors in the CloudTrail for the same timeframe: `kms:Decrypt AccessDenied` for the customer CMK alias/rdw-paxos-key. candidate cause: CMK policy changed/rotation or grant expiry. can we get the exact kms key id from the forwarder logs?

kevin: yes log line includes `x-kms-key-id=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01`. forwarding to ops to check grants.

sre-oncall-bot: deploy-bot: rollback of forwarder v2.14.0 -> v2.13.7 initiated by @kevin at 2026-11-03T04:05Z; build 8421.

aditya: rollback is fine short-term but paxos-inc still needs backfill for the missing window. we should confirm whether objects are present in the bucket (unreadable) or were never written.

audit-forwarder-bot: metric: forwarder.upload.success=15432 forwarder.upload.fail=314 (1h window) forwarder.kms.decrypt.errors=298 forwarder.s3.403=298

sam: if objects exist but KMS blocked decrypt, we can coordinate with customer KMS admin to re-grant decrypt for the Redwood service principal (`arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/rdw-exporter`) or use a re-encrypt/backfill job that reads via a temporary role. need approval from security for cross-account access.

maria: @sam correct. I checked KMS key policy history — there was a policy update at 2026-11-03T02:58Z that removed `Allow` for `rdw-exporter` principal (looks like an internal change at paxos side). Contacted paxos SRE and they're reverting. will post update.

aditya: customer confirms they reverted policy at 03:50 UTC but still seeing gaps until 04:10. possible replay throttling / index latency on SIEM side.

kevin: forwarder had a backlog; code path queues failed uploads locally and retries. we have the local backlog manifest on node `fw-12a`. steps to repro: `aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-audit-paxos --prefix=2026/11/03/03/` then try `aws s3 cp s3://... ./sample.gz` should yield 403 if still KMS-blocked.

sam: noted. paxos SRE says they restored key policy and will re-run re-encrypt script for the affected objects. action: paxos to confirm when objects are re-encrypted/accessible, then we trigger forwarder replay job for 03:00–03:45.

maria: if they can't re-encrypt, we can run a server-side re-encrypt using a temporary grant but need paxos sign-off — I'm drafting an approval template.

aditya: for customer comms — I'll tell them the Root Cause is a customer-side KMS policy change that prevented decrypts during 03:00–03:50. we're offering to: 1) assist with re-encrypt/replay 2) provide evidence (forwarder logs + cloudtrail) and 3) offer a 1-week retention extension for the backfill window.

kevin: follow-up: we should patch forwarder to surface KMS-grant expiry alerts earlier (emit SLI when decrypt errors spike) and add an automated retry with exponential backoff + alert to pager when >1000 decrypt errors/5m. filing ticket ENG-1349.

sam: paxos just confirmed re-encrypt completed at 2026-11-03T05:22Z. I kicked off replay job `replay --org paxos-inc --start 2026-11-03T03:00 --end 2026-11-03T03:45 --priority high`. monitoring ingest.

aditya: great. keep me posted. once replay completes we'll validate counts against their SIEM query and close ticket.

kevin: replay succeeded for ~9,820 events, 180 events dropped due to schema mismatch (old events missing metadata.field_x). log: `replay: uploaded=9820 dropped=180 reason=dropped_transform_schema`. sharing fix for schema mapping in ENG-1360.

maria: schema drops look like older agents used v1 payload (no field_x). we can supply migration script or ask paxos to accept legacy mapping.

aditya: agreed. next actions summarized: 1) close loop w/ paxos on replay result (aditya) 2) ENG to add KMS-grant monitoring + backoff (kevin) 3) product to surface export health in console (sam). I'll draft customer note.

sam: noted. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall-bot: incident-note: created postmortem draft INC-7192-PAXOS in confluence /incidents/7192.

aditya: thanks all — moving this thread to #incidents for postmortem. will update ticket when final counts validated.

kevin: FYI for records — grep-able log snippet I used: `grep "AccessDenied" /var/log/forwarder/fw-12a/2026-11-03.log | head -n 50`

maria: closing loop: paxos confirmed final counts match after replay, closing customer ticket. leaving postmortem to ENG+SEC. :white_check_mark:
